files.rationale: Python import marker is replaced by Cargo module declarations.
Retain typed configuration and preservation rules; R1 adds read-only validation and records deliberate corrections.
Preserve selected native discovery and bounded protocol cleanup; separate actual client evaluation.
Preserve immutable setup and recovery while separating the executable from embedded/versioned bundles.
Preserve execution, cleanup, resource ownership and truthful evidence semantics.
Preserve queue revision, ownership, worktree and observation contracts.
Replace Python entrypoint; preserve established command readiness and document additive validation plus versioned diagnostics.

R2a replaces source staging; R2c adds genuine Cargo archive inspection and extracted-source consumers. Staged sibling versions, omitted library locks and remaining registry-resolution gates are explicit.
Keep layout, link and ownership checks independent of game compilation.
R2b retains committed routing, ordered selected commands and failing final gates; tokenized includes and strict input corrections are recorded below.
Preserve observable consumer graph and selected package contents; replace interpreter-based fixtures with Rust probes.
Preserve observable layout, local links and dependency direction; replace interpreter-based fixtures with Rust probes.
R2b preserves 26 frozen tests across ci_routing.rs and ci_checks.rs, plus both R2a additions and executable protocol regressions in ci_cli.rs.
Port preservation/import contracts; retire old install/sync entrypoints at R7 rather than maintain two installers.
Preserve structural package, native metadata, link and scenario validation.
Validate frozen legacy inputs during transition; retire the Python launcher after its Rust replacement.
Preserve observable malformed and valid package metadata, references and scenarios; replace interpreter-based fixtures with Rust probes.
Preserve observable R3 native protocol fixtures and R5 compiled subprocess cleanup probes; replace interpreter-based fixtures with Rust probes.
Preserve observable isolated pinned sources, user-owned files and installation recovery; replace interpreter-based fixtures with Rust probes.
Preserve observable compiled child processes, resource locks and actual evidence records; replace interpreter-based fixtures with Rust probes.
Preserve observable real Git worktrees, revision guards and recorded transitions; replace interpreter-based fixtures with Rust probes.
Translate legacy preservation guarantees to explicit import; obsolete updater commands retire at R7.

changes.before: The config command requires the installed pinned candidate.
changes.after: Add config validate --file as a read-only structural check without setup; bare config remains unported.
changes.rationale: Validate configuration during migration without claiming installation or runtime readiness.

changes.before: Python errors include unversioned error strings and argparse output.
changes.after: Rust errors use schema_version=1 and error.code/error.message, exit 2; help/version remain text.
changes.rationale: Stable machine-readable failures distinguish unavailable operations from valid checks.

changes.before: Python equality admits schema_version=true as equal to 1.
changes.after: Require integer schema_version=1.
changes.rationale: Keep declarative schema types strict.

changes.before: Python config accepts a non-table project field.
changes.after: Require project to be a table when present.
changes.rationale: Reject malformed structure before later consumers attempt to read fields.

changes.before: Path checks depend on the host OS and malformed path types can raise uncaught exceptions.
changes.after: Require string paths with portable relative components; reject backslashes, colons, NUL, absolute paths and parent traversal on all hosts.
changes.rationale: A configuration must not gain escape semantics on a different host.

changes.before: Python permits duplicate target package names.
changes.after: Reject duplicate target packages as well as unknown or unselected names.
changes.rationale: Make package selection unambiguous at every level.

changes.before: Unquoted TOML dates can fail JSON output; nonfinite numbers are not portable JSON values.
changes.after: Reject unquoted dates and nonfinite numbers with structured configuration errors.
changes.rationale: Prevent data coercion or malformed JSON from being mistaken for a successful check.

changes.before: The Python baseline parses TOML 1.0.
changes.after: The selected Rust TOML parser also accepts TOML 1.1 syntax; configuration field/type rules still apply.
changes.rationale: Use the maintained Rust parser while making broader syntax acceptance explicit.

changes.before: Four Python validator entrypoints emit text or optional unversioned JSON.
changes.after: gamekit-repo check, skills validate, skills legacy and distribution check return schema_version=1 JSON. Validation rejection exits 1; invalid arguments and unported operations exit 2. skills validate accepts --json explicitly.
changes.rationale: One Rust owner per replaced command, with structural evidence limits retained.

changes.before: Malformed manifests and path types can raise exceptions; missing workspace aliases can silently skip ownership checks. The Markdown scanner toggles on any fence and does not understand reference definitions.
changes.after: Return actionable input failures, reject undefined inherited dependencies and nonportable dependency paths, resolve symlink ancestors before missing leaves, and check reference/title/encoded links outside matching fences. HTTP(S) and mail links are external; unsupported URI schemes fail.
changes.rationale: Fail invalid structure without hiding capability ownership or broken local links.

changes.before: Empty native manifests can bypass identity checks; contained symlinks can evade full directory auditing. Observation rubrics can demand and forbid the same text.
changes.after: Validate empty native manifests, reject all native package symlinks and contradictory observation rubrics. Legacy malformed trigger shapes and recursive duplicate JSON keys return failures.
changes.rationale: Make structural validation deterministic and keep package boundaries explicit without claiming native behavior.

changes.before: A textual workspace-header replacement drops unrelated fields and assumes one TOML layout. Graph checks reject games but omit tool packages and can accept incomplete nonempty graphs.
changes.after: Edit only membership/default-members/exclude structurally, reject game/tool dependencies, require probe and facade in every graph, and reject duplicate/nonportable source entries. Embed the unchanged consumer fixture in the repository-tool crate.
changes.rationale: Preserve independent source consumption and shared settings across valid TOML layouts. Actual GameKit archive inspection remains outstanding.

changes.before: CI invokes Python validators and routes their old source paths.
changes.after: CI bootstraps the pinned Rust repository tool, calls its validators, verifies its Cargo package and selects skill/distribution checks for affected repository-tool implementations. Old-path routing remains for historical diffs; docs/game isolation and the Python final gate remain.
changes.rationale: Cut callers over without losing failure semantics or migrating the R2b selector early.
changes.evidence: Historical R2a scripts/tests/test_ci.py at 955fdc98b0b8776cd98d50bdf7ef7d64a4910e39; preserved by tests/ci_checks.rs::skills_and_distribution_call_rust_validators and tests/ci_routing.rs::test_repository_tool_changes_keep_owned_validation_without_game_tests in the repository-tool crate.

changes.before: Windows Cargo can emit native backslash-separated package entries while portable validation expects slash-separated paths.
changes.after: Normalize separators only at the native Cargo listing boundary before validating relative components and duplicate entries; reject absolute, drive, UNC, dot, empty and parent components. Unix literal backslash names remain rejected.
changes.rationale: Accept real Windows Cargo output without weakening package containment or allowing alternate spellings to bypass duplicate detection.

changes.before: Python owns classification, selected command execution and the final gate.
changes.after: Rust ci select/run/gate and package-local tests replace the two Python files; only the skill matrix still installs Python for runtime tests. The final gate builds the checked-out Rust source with locked dependencies and fails if bootstrap fails. CI sources/tests and their shared entrypoints select the full suite.
changes.rationale: Preserve full-scope confidence when changing the system that decides which checks run. Archive inspection and bundle preparation remain separate R2 work.

changes.before: The regex misses whitespace before an include macro bang and treats comments/string lookalikes as code; raw and escaped strings fall back.
changes.after: Tokenize Rust include macros across comments, whitespace, raw identifiers and delimiters; decode ordinary/raw string literals. Dynamic or unparseable inputs select all checks. Git paths remain POSIX on each host; unsupported/escaping paths and uncertain globs also select all checks.
changes.rationale: Compiled documentation and assets must not be skipped because of valid Rust spelling.

changes.before: Python accepts boolean schema_version=1 and duplicate JSON keys, leaves parts of selection shape unchecked, and emits text exceptions.
changes.after: Require typed version-one selection, reject unknown fields and recursive duplicate keys, preserve GitHub selection/boolean outputs, and emit versioned diagnostics. ci run streams child output before final JSON, uses literal argv and returns failure immediately on a child error.
changes.rationale: Malformed selections, classifier failures and missing/cancelled/unexpectedly skipped jobs cannot produce a passing gate.

changes.before: Running the CI controller from the workspace CI target locks its executable on Windows; workspace tests can need to replace it after feature unification.
changes.after: CI bootstraps its controller in target/ci-controller while child commands retain their ordinary workspace target and cache. Local Cargo invocation documentation uses that same separate directory.
changes.rationale: Retain Windows checks and ordinary Cargo artifact reuse without replacing the running executable.
changes.evidence: tools/gamekit-repo-tools/tests/ci_cli.rs::isolated_controller_allows_cargo_to_rebuild_the_tested_binary; initial Windows CI run 34612173371 established the collision.

changes.before: External consumer checks compile Cargo-selected staging sources without creating Cargo archives.
changes.after: distribution archives produces Cargo .crate files, validates paths/normalized manifests/source bytes, deletes the staging workspace and tests empty/pure/UI/network consumers of extracted sources. Temporary version requirements and omitted library lockfiles are reported; local patches do not claim registry resolution.
changes.rationale: Verify actual artifact contents and isolated consumption while public manifests remain unpublished.
changes.evidence: tools/gamekit-repo-tools/tests/distribution_archives.rs; distribution archives JSON report and hosted selected Rust jobs.

changes.before: The CLI package has no package-local baseline instruction snapshot; canonical skills and Python runtime share plugin directories.
changes.after: Rust bundle prepare/check/export generates and verifies a pinned deterministic instruction-only tarball plus manifest under the CLI package. bundle verify-package compares actual CLI archive bytes; CI checks drift on relevant changes. Default packages remain core-only and activation remains preparation-only.
changes.rationale: Prepare one canonical source for embedded and standalone artifacts without prematurely activating Python-oriented instructions or replacing R3 installation owners.
